summary:
中文医疗AI周报（仅依据输入条目归纳；[编号]对应输入条目）

一、研究进展
- 可解释多模态医学视觉语言基础模型EVLF-FM覆盖6个专科、10种影像模态、18个数据集、130余万样本，并在17个外部数据集13443例独立样本上验证，支持诊断、视觉问答与像素级定位[1]。
- 放射技师前瞻性使用AI骨折检测：单急诊科三个月、13名技师、2496例配对读片，准确率由97.6%升至98.0%；AI单独敏感度75.6%，隐匿骨折仅46.2%；技师基线敏感度91.6%，AI辅助净纠正10例[2]。
- 眼底荧光血管造影可解释图推理框架FFA-RGNet基于多中心25312张图像、2651例患者建模病灶时序与解剖模式，内部测试F1达95.38%，多中心与前瞻性验证集表现一致，优于九个基线[3]。
- 数字病理空间肿瘤微环境图学习框架GTMA在1871例队列及TCGA-STAD 213例中验证，风险评分可补充TNM分期并识别同期同亚型高危患者[5]。
- AnySleep支持任意EEG/EOG通道配置、时间分辨率可调，训练验证覆盖28个数据集、逾20万小时信号，多中心泛化表现达当前最优水平[6]。
- MR-AI识别初级保健漏开专科转诊：新加坡七家基层诊所准实验，每周扫描约2.5万份记录，漏诊检出提升约七倍；特异性99.9%、敏感性48.8%；428例标记中225例经医生核实；与七名医生盲法比较，PPV 61.8%对51.8%[7]。
- 慢乙肝住院多结局风险分层基于22001名患者、36024条住院记录，每结局选15个主效应特征加4个交互项，采用时间验证、独立外部验证、校准和决策曲线[8]。
- AI骨折检测伞形综述纳入50篇系统综述或荟萃分析、387项原始研究；21项荟萃分析二次合并重叠度仅4.31%，合并敏感度0.897，95%预测区间0.753–0.962[9]。
- 颈髓自动标注与形态测量框架训练数据含998名对照与879例遗传性共济失调患者、覆盖32个站点，比较nnU-Net、深监督U-Net与SwinUNETR，并用4个公开数据集2737例MRI做外部验证[10]。
- 可解释AI用于糖尿病足溃疡预后评估与决策：多中心推导与验证并含前瞻性随机评估；作者提示复发预测结果需谨慎解读[11]。
- 对话式AI在单中心基层医疗场景的可行性与安全性表现初步积极，作者称需更大规模评估[12]。
- 围手术期感染预测模型部署前审计纳入10719例手术、504例术后感染，总体AUROC 0.876；按性别、年龄与生理储备亚组审计校准与临床效用，并比较多种重校准策略；属回顾性分析，非前瞻性临床结局验证[13]。
- 医学大模型临床推理不稳定性研究用3035条系统扰动测试GPT-5等三个模型，仅提示格式变化即可使分期准确率波动超50%；信息不足时仍给出确定性分期结论；在5万份MIMIC-IV病历上训练稀疏自编码器解析表征，MedGemma呈现分层编码[14]。
- 合成临床文本系统综述从1398篇中筛出94篇，2018年后相关研究显著增多，用途含文本增强、辅助书写、语料构建与隐私保护，并分析生成技术与评估方法[15]。
- 机器学习预测癌症患者治疗后48–72小时持续发热：两家学术医院EHR开发与外部验证，最佳模型内部AUROC 0.82、外部0.78，体温相关变量为主要预测因子，决策曲线分析显示净获益为正向[16]。
- 大语言模型驱动的多模态临床预测系统综述筛检641项、纳入57项，归纳嵌入、信息抽取与文本融合三类整合策略，相较单模态模型平均性能提升约6.4%[19]。
- MorphX从全切片病理图像预测HCC与LUAD生存，跨独立队列验证并识别8个形态学生物标志物[20]。
- 大语言模型与诊治医生推荐治疗方案费用比较已在NEJM AI提前在线发表，输入仅给出比较主题，未见具体结果[21]。
- 可变形图像配准基础模型预训练策略MPM-Reg用掩码位置建模训练纯Transformer配准模型，目标是跨模态、跨解剖部位迁移[23]。
- 医学影像AI漂移监测框架MMC+整合多数据流统计检验与距离度量，利用基础模型嵌入免去院内编码器训练，并以新冠期间麻省总医院数据验证[25]。
- 放射AI自动化偏差与技能退化讨论指出：AI错误输出会降低判读准确性且与经验无关；辅助收益因读片者与任务而异，撤除后表现下降；提出置信度分层分诊模型[26]。
- 孕妇与产后女性对生成式AI健康教育内容信任度的预注册随机调查研究n=400，随机署名医师、AI、医AI协作或无作者，评估吸引力、内容信任及对推荐医师信任，80%参与者通过时间与注意力检查[27]。
- 大语言模型辅助放射报告质控在多中心真实临床场景、X线/CT/MRI多模态多解剖部位中评估可行性、准确性与泛化性，并与其他方法头对头比较[28]。
- 不确定性AI临床落地路线图从临床视角梳理不确定性量化，提出将不确定性估计转化为临床行动的实践路线图，强调针对临床相关错误验证并嵌入真实工作流与治理框架[42]。
- 神经退行性疾病跨模态深度学习系统综述纳入2019年至2026年4月的111项研究，按早期预测、诊断、进展三阶段分层评估，指出模型性能高度依赖数据可得性与多样性[49]。
- 方法学输入还包括：HistoDiffusion++病理生成式视觉基础模型[17]、分层多图谱融合网络用于跨站点重性抑郁障碍功能连接组分析[18]、半监督学习与生存模型对齐的可扩展癌症预后[31]、物理信息隐式神经表示的无监督3D MRI运动校正[32]、MoRe-3DGSMR自由呼吸肺MRI运动分辨重建[33]、PDFormer量化帕金森病运动症状[35]、文本提示高斯泼溅用于4D手术场景理解[36]、分布匹配个性化联邦学习用于多中心跨模态肝脏配准[37]、内镜视频状态变化未来事件预测[39]、MSRepaint多发性硬化病灶填充与合成[40]、元分析提示引导多任务图Transformer联合分析认知缺陷与精神障碍[41]、GeoMind对称正定流形上的脑节律建模[50]；其中多条仅见题录或方法描述，验证细节不足[32][35][37][39][41]。
- 预印本输入包括：EchoChat基于46358例超声心动图指令数据训练，在六个国际队列评测并报告当前最优性能[45]；多轮强化学习训练的精神科接诊语言模型在120次访谈、15名精神科医师盲评中，76.7%配对场景优于基座模型[44]；TRACER基于EHR在4家系统450万患者预训练，外部验证200万患者、16种疾病1/2/5年风险预测[38]；早期黑色素瘤常规病理深度学习研究基于荷兰人群，发现集328例、验证队列5500例以上巢式病例对照，提示可提供AJCC分期外信息[46]。

二、落地监管
- 据输入，FDA批准Deep Reasoning AI的NeuroDR用于神经血管CT扫描[43]；该条仅有标题信息，具体性能与适用范围待核实。
- 环境AI记录员学术医疗系统采纳模式：2901名门诊临床医生、2024年12月至2025年5月，社区内科67%、社区儿科69%、学术神经科53%采纳；学术普外16%、妇产科18%采纳较低[22]。
- 肺结节纵向AI辅助管理注册一项6000例干预性随机试验，对真实序列CT做结节匹配与变化测量，主要终点为24个月内良性病理肺切除比例，同时评估诊断延迟、分期与并发症；目前为注册新闻，尚无结果[24]。
- 临床预测模型外部验证与临床落地系统综述追踪1072个机器学习临床预测模型，仅9.9%完成外部验证、5.2%进入临床实施、88.1%无转化随访；公开代码与TRIPOD依从性提高转化几率[4]。
- 围手术期感染预测模型按亚组审计校准、阈值误差与决策曲线净收益，并比较无重校准、通用与分组交叉等渗重校准及时间外推，属部署前审计[13]。
- 不确定性AI落地路线图提出将不确定性估计转化为临床行动，并嵌入真实工作流与治理框架[42]；放射AI讨论提出置信度分层分诊模型以融入工作流[26]。

三、产业动态
- 本期输入未提供融资、并购或商业合作条目；可直接对应产品采纳/获批的事实为：学术医疗系统环境AI记录员采纳率差异[22]；FDA批准NeuroDR用于神经血管CT[43]。
- 与产品使用相关的输入还包括：对话式AI在单中心基层医疗的初步可行性与安全性评估[12]；环境AI记录员在2901名门诊临床医生中的月度使用差异[22]。

四、限制与待核实
- 预印本证据需待同行评审与结果核实：TRACER[38]、精神科接诊强化学习模型[44]、EchoChat[45]、早期黑色素瘤病理深度学习研究[46]。
- 仅题录/标题或细节不足：NeuroDR[43]、内脏动脉瘤筛查框架[29]、T2ID[34]、PDFormer[35]、肝脏图像配准联邦学习[37]、内镜未来事件预测[39]、元分析提示图Transformer[41]、自动化偏见观点文章[47]；3D MRI运动校正条目未见验证规模[32]。
- 注册/新闻不等同于结果：肺结节AI辅助管理随机试验为注册信息，尚无结果[24]；LLM与诊治医生推荐方案费用比较输入未给具体结果[21]。
- 真实世界与部署限制：骨折AI真实世界研究为单急诊科三个月，准确率提升幅度小，AI单独敏感度75.6%、隐匿骨折46.2%[2]；围手术期感染模型审计为回顾性分析[13]；对话式AI为单中心初步评估，需更大规模评估[12]；糖尿病足溃疡作者提示复发预测需谨慎[11]。
- 转化缺口：1072个机器学习临床预测模型中仅9.9%外部验证、5.2%临床实施、88.1%无转化随访[4]。
- 大模型稳定性与人类因素：仅提示格式变化可使分期准确率波动超50%，信息不足仍给确定结论[14]；AI错误输出会降低判读准确性，辅助收益异质，撤除后表现下降[26]；另有观点文章讨论自动化偏见与医生认知主权[47]。
- 证据汇总类输入：AI骨折检测伞形综述[9]、合成临床文本系统综述[15]、LLM多模态临床预测系统综述[19]、慢性创面数据集方法与转化综述[30]、神经退行性疾病系统综述[49]均为证据汇总；其中神经退行性疾病综述指出性能高度依赖数据可得性与多样性[49]。
- 生成式AI信任调查为n=400的预注册随机调查研究，80%参与者通过时间与注意力检查[27]；放射报告质控评估覆盖多中心真实报告并做头对头比较[28]。

items.title: A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability
items.zh_title: 可解释多模态医学视觉语言基础模型EVLF-FM
items.summary: EVLF-FM覆盖10种影像模态、18个数据集共130余万样本，外部验证1.3万余例，支持诊断、视觉问答与像素级定位。
key_points: 覆盖皮肤、病理、眼科等6个专科10种模态
开发与测试合计超130万样本、18个数据集
17个外部数据集13443例独立样本验证
items.reason: 大规模多模态基础模型+独立外部验证，同行评审，属重要档
items.abstract: Despite their considerable promise, many current medical foundation models remain modality specific and lack transparent reasoning, limiting clinical adoption. To address this gap, we introduce Explainable Vision Language Foundation Model for Medicine (EVLF-FM), a multimodal vision language foundation model that combines broad diagnostic capabilities with fine-grained explainability. The development and testing of EVLF-FM encompassed more than 1.3 million total samples from 18 global datasets across 10 imaging modalities related to six clinical specialties: dermatology, hepatology, ophthalmology, pathology, pulmonology and radiology. External validation employed 13,443 independent test samples from 17 additional datasets across 10 imaging modalities. EVLF-FM supports disease diagnosis, visual question answering and pixel-level visual grounding with reasoning capabilities. In internal validation for disease diagnostics, EVLF-FM achieved the highest average accuracy, 0.895, outperforming leading generalist and specialist models. In medical visual grounding, EVLF-FM also achieved reasonable performance across nine modalities with average accuracy at 0.5 intersection over union (Acc@0.5) of 0.842. External testing further confirmed consistent zero-shot and few-shot performance, with competitive F1 scores despite a smaller model size. A hybrid training strategy combining supervised and visual reinforcement fine-tuning enables EVLF-FM to generate clinically interpretable explanations aligned with visual evidence. Human evaluation of these reasoning outputs using the S.C.O.R.E. framework yielded a high overall mean score of 4.25/5, supporting their clinical interpretability. Current limitations include the need for additional validation across diverse healthcare settings. Prospective clinical studies are required to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and clinical utility of EVLF-FM before routine clinical deployment.
items.zh_abstract: 尽管具有相当大的前景，许多当前的医学基础模型仍局限于特定模态，并缺乏透明推理，限制了临床采用。为弥补这一空白，我们引入可解释医学视觉语言基础模型（Explainable Vision Language Foundation Model for Medicine, EVLF-FM），这是一种多模态视觉语言基础模型，将广泛的诊断能力与细粒度可解释性相结合。EVLF-FM 的开发和测试涵盖来自18个全球数据集的超过130万份总样本，涉及10种成像模态，与六个临床专科相关：皮肤科、肝病科、眼科、病理科、肺科和放射科。外部验证使用了来自另外17个数据集的13,443份独立测试样本，涵盖10种成像模态。EVLF-FM 支持疾病诊断、视觉问答和具有推理能力的像素级视觉定位。在疾病诊断的内部验证中，EVLF-FM 取得最高平均准确率0.895，优于领先的通用型和专科模型。在医学视觉定位中，EVLF-FM 在九种模态上也取得了合理性能，交并比0.5下的平均准确率（Acc@0.5）为0.842。外部测试进一步证实了稳定的零样本和少样本性能，尽管模型规模较小，仍具有有竞争力的 F1 分数。结合监督学习和视觉强化微调的混合训练策略使 EVLF-FM 能够生成与视觉证据一致的临床可解释的说明。使用 S.C.O.R.E. 框架对这些推理输出进行人工评估，总体平均分高达4.25/5，支持其临床可解释性。当前局限包括需要在多样化医疗环境中进行额外验证。在常规临床部署之前，需要进行前瞻性临床研究以评估 EVLF-FM 的安全性、有效性和临床效用。

items.zh_title: 放射技师前瞻性使用AI骨折检测的真实世界评估
items.summary: 单急诊科三个月前瞻部署中，13名放射技师读取2496例肌骨检查，AI辅助使准确率由97.6%小幅升至98.0%。
key_points: 2496例连续检查、2496次配对读片
AI单独敏感度75.6%，隐匿骨折仅46.2%
技师基线敏感度91.6%，AI辅助净纠正10例
items.reason: 前瞻性真实部署、样本数千且报告工作流效果，属重要档
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems for fracture detection perform strongly in controlled settings, but prospective real-world evidence is limited. In a three-month deployment in one emergency department, thirteen radiographers in a radiographer-led screening programme independently interpreted 2496 consecutive musculoskeletal examinations (one radiographer per examination), reviewed output from a commercial deep-learning system, then recorded a final decision, giving 2496 paired reads against a radiologist reference standard. Standalone AI sensitivity was 75.6%, falling to 46.2% for subtle fractures, below the radiographers’ baseline sensitivity of 91.6%. Radiographers’ baseline accuracy was high (97.6%; specificity 99.0%) and improved modestly with AI assistance (98.0%; exact McNemar p = 0.0064). With AI assistance, radiographers corrected 11 errors and introduced 1, a net gain of 10 cases. Subgroup gains were directionally consistent but not significant after correction. Radiographers changed their decision in only 11 of 729 discordant cases, and most negative interactions were correct AI recommendations not adopted. No or incomplete AI output was returned for 8.8% of acquired examinations. AI assistance delivered a small, selective benefit arising from complementary rather than superior algorithmic performance. Operational reliability proved as consequential as diagnostic accuracy, and behavioural inferences rest on few events. Downstream clinical outcomes were not measured.
items.zh_abstract: 用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）系统在受控环境中表现强劲，但前瞻性真实世界证据有限。在一个急诊科为期三个月的部署中，13名放射技师在由放射技师主导的筛查项目中独立解读了2496次连续的肌肉骨骼检查（每次检查由一名放射技师解读），审查了商业深度学习系统的输出，然后记录最终决定，从而产生了2496次与放射科医生参考标准配对的判读。独立AI的敏感度为75.6%，对于细微骨折降至46.2%，低于放射技师的基线敏感度91.6%。放射技师的基线准确率高（97.6%；特异度99.0%），并在AI辅助下略有提高（98.0%；精确McNemar p = 0.0064）。在AI辅助下，放射技师纠正了11个错误并引入了1个错误，净增加10例。亚组获益方向一致，但校正后不显著。放射技师仅在729例不一致病例中的11例改变了决定，大多数负向交互是未采纳正确的AI建议。8.8%的已采集检查返回了无AI输出或不完整AI输出。AI辅助带来了小幅、选择性的获益，其来源于互补而非优越的算法性能。操作可靠性与诊断准确性同样重要，而行为推断仅基于少数事件。未测量下游临床结局。

items.abstract: Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) is the gold standard for diagnosing retinal vascular diseases. However, interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) systems for FFA image analysis that align with clinicians’ reasoning processes and real-world diagnostic workflows remain scarce. In this study, we introduce an interpretable graph reasoning framework, FFA-RGNet, that explicitly models the temporal patterns of fine-grained lesions across imaging phases and anatomical locations for disease diagnosis from sequential FFA images. FFA-RGNet was trained and validated on a large, fine-grained, multi-center dataset consisting of 25,312 FFA images from 2651 patients. FFA-RGNet outperformed nine baseline models on the internal test set, achieving an F1-score of 95.38% (95% CI: 92.24%–97.88%), and demonstrated consistent performance across multi-center and prospective validation datasets. Its diagnostic performance not only surpassed that of ophthalmologists, residents and ophthalmology students, but also improved their diagnostic F1-score by 7.48% to 14.11% when used as an assistive tool. Comprehensive inference analysis further revealed its superior ability to correctly recognize fine-grained semantic entities, and to learn stable, disease-specific graph reasoning patterns aligned with clinical knowledge. These results suggest that FFA-RGNet enables accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning progresses, highlighting its strong potential as a reliable AI system for FFA interpretation and clinical decision support.
items.zh_abstract: 眼底荧光素血管造影（fundus fluorescein angiography，FFA）是诊断视网膜血管疾病的金标准。然而，用于FFA图像分析、与临床医生推理过程和真实世界诊断工作流程相一致的可解释人工智能（AI）系统仍然稀缺。在本研究中，我们介绍了一个可解释的图推理框架FFA-RGNet，该框架明确建模细粒度病变在成像阶段和解剖位置上的时间模式，以从序列FFA图像中进行疾病诊断。FFA-RGNet在一个大型、细粒度、多中心数据集上进行了训练和验证，该数据集包含来自2651例患者的25,312张FFA图像。FFA-RGNet在内部测试集上优于九个基线模型，达到95.38%的F1分数（95% CI：92.24%–97.88%），并在多中心和前瞻性验证数据集上表现一致。其诊断性能不仅超过了眼科医生、住院医师和眼科学生，而且作为辅助工具使用时，将其诊断F1分数提高了7.48%至14.11%。全面的推理分析进一步揭示了其正确识别细粒度语义实体以及学习与临床知识一致的、稳定的疾病特异性图推理模式的优越能力。这些结果表明，FFA-RGNet能够以可解释的推理过程实现准确诊断，突显其作为用于FFA解读和临床决策支持的可靠AI系统的强大潜力。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To assess whether external validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models reflect sequential or distinct stages of a translational pathway. This cross-sectional meta-epidemiologic study analyzed 1072 machine learning-based clinical prediction models published across clinical domains (2017-2019). We assessed downstream external validation and clinical implementation via citation screening through August 2025. Evaluated exposures included public code availability, TRIPOD adherence, multicenter design, and sample size. Secondary outcomes included investigator overlap. Among 1072 studies, 88.1% lacked translational follow-up. Only 9.9% underwent external validation, and 5.2% reached clinical implementation. Code availability (odds ratio [OR] 3.04; 95% CI, 1.91-4.84) and higher TRIPOD adherence (OR 2.68 per 10% increase; 95% CI, 2.04-3.52) were significantly associated with external validation, but not consistently with clinical implementation. Notably, 39% of implemented models lacked prior external validation. Independent groups predominantly conducted external validation (72.6%), whereas implementation frequently involved original development teams. Findings indicate a divergence in algorithmic translation. Characteristics emphasizing evaluability (code availability, reporting transparency) facilitate external validation but do not ensure clinical implementation. The frequent bypass of independent validation before implementation highlights a reliance on institutional and operational factors rather than generalizable methodology. External validation and clinical implementation appear to represent distinct translational processes rather than sequential stages influenced by a uniform set of factors. Current practices facilitate validation but inadequately address operational requirements for real-world deployment.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 评估临床预测模型的外部验证和临床实施是否反映转化路径中的连续阶段还是不同阶段。这项横断面元流行病学研究分析了 2017-2019 年在各临床领域发表的 1072 个基于机器学习的临床预测模型。我们通过截至 2025 年 8 月的引文筛选评估了下游外部验证和临床实施。评估的暴露因素包括公共代码可用性、TRIPOD 依从性、多中心设计和样本量。次要结局包括研究者重叠。在 1072 项研究中，88.1% 缺乏转化随访。仅 9.9% 进行了外部验证，5.2% 达到临床实施。代码可用性（比值比 [OR] 3.04；95% CI，1.91-4.84）和更高的 TRIPOD 依从性（每增加 10%，OR 2.68；95% CI，2.04-3.52）与外部验证显著相关，但与临床实施并不一致相关。值得注意的是，39% 已实施的模型缺乏先前外部验证。独立团队主要进行外部验证（72.6%），而实施常涉及原始开发团队。研究结果表明算法转化存在分歧。强调可评估性的特征（代码可用性、报告透明度）促进外部验证，但不确保临床实施。实施前经常绕过独立验证，凸显对机构和操作因素的依赖，而非可推广的方法学。外部验证和临床实施似乎代表不同的转化过程，而不是受一组统一因素影响的连续阶段。当前实践促进了验证，但不足以满足真实世界部署的操作要求。

items.abstract: Current gastric cancer (GC) risk stratification, based on TNM staging and molecular subtypes, often fails to capture intratumoral heterogeneity driving variable outcomes. Although the tumor microenvironment (TME) spatial architecture within histopathological images holds critical prognostic value, quantifying these interactions remains challenging. We present the Graph-based Tumor Microenvironment Aggregation (GTMA) framework, an interpretable deep learning approach modeling whole-slide images as spatial graphs to decipher tissue interactions. Validated in a large cohort ( n = 1871) and TCGA-STAD dataset ( n = 213), the GTMA-derived Risk Score (RS) provided prognostic information complementary to TNM staging and clinical models. Notably, the RS stratified patients into distinct risk groups within identical TNM stages and molecular subtypes, identifying high-risk patients traditionally overlooked. Integrative analysis revealed high-RS tumors feature a fibroblast-dominant, immune-excluded phenotype and distinct stromal spatial patterns. By linking digital pathology to biological TME patterns, GTMA offers a robust, interpretable AI tool for individualized prognostic risk stratification and precision oncology in GC.
items.zh_abstract: 当前基于TNM分期和分子亚型的胃癌（GC）风险分层，常常无法捕捉导致结局差异的瘤内异质性。尽管组织病理学图像中的肿瘤微环境（TME）空间结构具有关键预后价值，但量化这些相互作用仍然具有挑战性。我们提出基于图的肿瘤微环境聚合（GTMA）框架，这是一种可解释的深度学习方法，将全切片图像建模为空间图以解析组织相互作用。在一个大型队列（n = 1871）和TCGA-STAD数据集（n = 213）中验证后，GTMA衍生的风险评分（RS）提供了与TNM分期和临床模型互补的预后信息。值得注意的是，RS在相同TNM分期和分子亚型内将患者分为不同风险组，识别出传统上被忽视的高风险患者。整合分析显示，高RS肿瘤具有成纤维细胞主导、免疫排斥的表型以及独特的间质空间模式。通过将数字病理学与生物学TME模式联系起来，GTMA为GC的个体化预后风险分层和精准肿瘤学提供了一种稳健、可解释的AI工具。

items.abstract: Sleep is essential for health, yet studying its dynamics requires manual sleep staging, a labor-intensive step in research and clinical care. Across centers, polysomnography (PSG) recordings are traditionally scored in 30-s epochs for pragmatic, not physiological, reasons and vary in electrode count, montage, and subject characteristics. These constraints challenge harmonized multi-center studies and the discovery of robust biomarkers on shorter timescales. We present AnySleep, a deep neural network that scores sleep from any electroencephalography (EEG) or electrooculography (EOG) data at adjustable temporal resolutions. We trained and validated the model on over 20,000 overnight recordings (>200,000 h of EEG and EOG) from 28 datasets across multiple clinics to promote robust generalization across sites. The model attains state-of-the-art performance and surpasses or equals established baselines at 30-s epochs. Performance improves with more channels, yet remains strong when EOG is absent, or only EOG or single EEG derivations (frontal, central, or occipital) are available. On sub-30-s timescales, the model captures short wake intrusions consistent with arousals and improves the prediction of pathophysiological conditions (obstructive sleep apnea, narcolepsy type 1, insomnia) over 30-s scoring. We make the model publicly available to facilitate large-scale studies with heterogeneous electrode setups and accelerate biomarker discovery in sleep.
items.zh_abstract: 睡眠对健康至关重要，但研究其动态变化需要人工睡眠分期，这是研究和临床护理中一项劳动密集型步骤。在不同中心，多导睡眠图（PSG）记录传统上以30秒epoch进行判读，这是出于实用性而非生理学原因，并且电极数量、导联组合和受试者特征各不相同。这些限制对协调一致的多中心研究以及在更短时间尺度上发现稳健生物标志物构成挑战。我们提出AnySleep，一种深度神经网络，可在可调的时间分辨率下从任何脑电图（EEG）或眼电图（EOG）数据中判读睡眠。我们在来自多个诊所的28个数据集、超过20,000次整夜记录（>200,000小时EEG和EOG）上训练并验证该模型，以促进跨站点的稳健泛化。该模型达到最先进性能，并在30秒epoch上超过或等于已有基线。性能随通道增多而提高，但在EOG缺失，或仅有EOG或单导EEG导出（额区、中央区或枕区）时仍保持较强。在低于30秒的时间尺度上，模型捕捉到与觉醒一致的短暂清醒侵入，并较30秒判读改善了对病理生理状况（阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停、1型发作性睡病、失眠）的预测。我们公开该模型，以促进具有异质电极设置的大规模研究，并加速睡眠中的生物标志物发现。

items.abstract: Missed specialist referrals in primary care pose substantial health and medico-legal risks, yet remain poorly understood. We developed an AI-supported safety system (MR-AI) to identify missed referrals from consultation notes, evaluated in a quasi-experimental study across seven primary care clinics in Singapore. MR-AI scanned ~25,000 notes weekly for referral intent without a corresponding order, achieving an estimated sevenfold increase in weekly missed referral detection (4.7 percentage point level increase; 95% CI 0.024–0.069; p < 0.001). Of 428 cases flagged, 225 were clinician-verified, alongside 31 patient-reported cases, yielding 256 total detections. MR-AI demonstrated 99.9% specificity and 48.8% sensitivity. In a blinded one-week comparison against seven physician reviewers, MR-AI achieved a PPV of 61.8% versus a human confirmation rate of 51.8% across 83 flagged cases, while requiring approximately 41 fewer projected staff-hours. AI-enabled surveillance substantially assisted in missed referral detection, though sustainable improvement will require complementary preventive workflow changes and future cost-effectiveness assessment.
items.zh_abstract: 基层医疗中遗漏专科转诊会带来重大的健康和医疗法律风险，但对此仍知之甚少。我们开发了一种人工智能支持的安全系统（MR-AI），用于从就诊记录中识别遗漏的转诊，并在新加坡七家基层医疗诊所开展的一项准实验研究中进行了评估。MR-AI每周扫描约25,000份记录，查找有转诊意图但无相应医嘱的情况，估计使每周遗漏转诊检出增加七倍（水平提高4.7个百分点；95% CI 0.024–0.069；p < 0.001）。在428例被标记的病例中，225例经临床医生核实，另有31例为患者报告病例，合计256例检出。MR-AI的特异性为99.9%，敏感性为48.8%。在与7名医师审阅者进行的为期一周的盲法比较中，在83例被标记病例中，MR-AI的阳性预测值（PPV）为61.8%，而人工确认率为51.8%，同时预计所需工作人员工时约减少41小时。人工智能支持的监测在很大程度上协助了遗漏转诊的检出，但可持续改善将需要配套的预防性工作流程变革以及未来的成本效益评估。

items.abstract: Clinical artificial intelligence (AI) often trades predictive performance against interpretability. This study develops an interpretability-driven feature engineering framework for multi-outcome risk stratification at hospitalization for chronic hepatitis B. A total of 36,024 hospitalization records from 22,001 patients were included. The framework integrating SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based main and interaction effects was used to construct compact machine learning models for classifying disease non-progression, liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). SHAP main effects selected the top 15 features per outcome; TreeSHAP interactions selected four pairwise terms. Performance was evaluated using patient-level data splitting, temporal validation, and independent external validation, with calibration and decision-curve analyses. The full-feature models achieved superior discrimination (AUCs: 0.927, 0.897, and 0.899) for classifying hospitalization-recorded disease non-progression, LC, and HCC, respectively. The corresponding compact models maintained strong discrimination (AUCs: 0.911, 0.882, and 0.890) with 80.8% fewer features. Interaction models yielded subtle AUC shifts (AUCs: 0.912, 0.881, and 0.891) while characterizing potential clinical joint-effect patterns. Temporal validation yielded AUCs of 0.863, 0.827, and 0.847, while external validation yielded AUCs of 0.829, 0.865, and 0.827, respectively. The framework produced compact and transparent models for contemporaneous risk stratification in clinical practice, seamlessly uniting predictive accuracy with multi-level interpretability.
items.zh_abstract: 临床人工智能（AI）常常在预测性能与可解释性之间权衡。本研究开发了一个可解释性驱动的特征工程框架，用于慢性乙型肝炎住院时的多结局风险分层。共纳入来自22,001名患者的36,024条住院记录。该框架整合基于SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）的主效应和交互效应，用于构建紧凑的机器学习模型，以分类疾病未进展、肝硬化（LC）和肝细胞癌（HCC）。SHAP主效应为每个结局选择前15个特征；TreeSHAP交互效应选择四个两两交互项。使用患者层面数据划分、时间验证和独立外部验证评估性能，并进行校准和决策曲线分析。全特征模型在分类住院记录中的疾病未进展、LC和HCC方面分别取得更优的区分度（AUC：0.927、0.897和0.899）。相应的紧凑模型在特征减少80.8%的情况下仍保持较强区分度（AUC：0.911、0.882和0.890）。交互模型带来细微的AUC变化（AUC：0.912、0.881和0.891），同时刻画了潜在的临床联合效应模式。时间验证的AUC分别为0.863、0.827和0.847，外部验证的AUC分别为0.829、0.865和0.827。该框架生成了用于临床实践中同期风险分层的紧凑且透明的模型，将预测准确性与多层级可解释性无缝结合。

items.abstract: Abstract Fractures affect approximately 178 million people annually, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools for fracture detection are increasingly approved by regulators. We conducted an umbrella review and second-order meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024516414), searching six databases to 4/06/2025 for systematic reviews or meta-analyses of AI fracture detection using any imaging modality. Screening, extraction, and quality assessment were performed in duplicate. We assessed review quality using AMSTAR-2, primary-study overlap using corrected covered area, and certainty using GRADE. Fifty reviews were included (25 systematic reviews and 25 meta-analyses; 387 primary studies). Twenty-one meta-analyses (269 primary studies) contributed to second-order meta-analysis, with slight overall overlap (4.31%). Pooled AI sensitivity was 0.897 (95% CI 0.882–0.911; 95% prediction interval 0.753–0.962) and specificity 0.904 (95% CI 0.891–0.916; prediction interval 0.824 to 0.950). Comparative evidence showed no consistent differences for AI, clinicians, and AI-assisted clinicians: however, this data was sparse and inconclusive. No review reported adverse events or other safety outcomes. Certainty was very low/low for almost all outcomes; all meta-analyses were rated critically low/low on AMSTAR-2. Although published estimates suggest high diagnostic accuracy, real-world and comparative performance remain uncertain. Prospective external validation, multi-reader-multi-case studies, and randomised trials are needed before broad clinical adoption.

items.abstract: Abstract This study aimed to develop and validate a fully automated pipeline for vertebral level identification (C1–C3) of the upper cervical spinal cord (SC) in T1-weighted brain MRI with a quality control module to assess the generated masks. MRI data from 998 controls and 879 patients with hereditary ataxias (32 sites; age 5–85 years; 46% male) were used to train deep learning models (nnU-Net, U-Net with deep supervision, SwinUNETR) for automatic vertebral labeling of C1–C3 levels. A secondary model based on VGG, ResNet, and EfficientNet architectures was trained to identify vertebral labeling errors. The pipeline also generates image quality metrics including signal-to-noise ratio, contrast-to-noise ratio, coefficient of joint variation, and entropy focus criterion. External validation was performed using 2737 MRIs from four public datasets, and clinical utility was demonstrated in a longitudinal cohort of 51 patients with multiple sclerosis. The nnU-Net achieved the highest performance (Dice: C1 = 0.85, C2 = 0.89, C3 = 0.89), labeling 95.8% of mislabeled cases from the Spinal Cord Toolbox. The VGG-based classifier achieved 97.9% accuracy and 98.7% sensitivity. External validation showed labeling accuracies exceeding 92% in four of five datasets and sensitivity to longitudinal SC atrophy in multiple sclerosis. This pipeline enables scalable, reliable vertebral labeling and morphometric extraction of the upper cervical SC for multicenter studies and supports biomarker development in neurodegenerative diseases.

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] We audited deployment readiness of an end-of-surgery postoperative infection model across clinically relevant subgroups and assessed mitigation of subgroup miscalibration. We analyzed out-of-fold predictions from 10 719 procedures (2014-2022) with 504 present-on-admission (POA)-coded postoperative infection events across recorded sex, age, and a clinical physiological-reserve proxy. We assessed discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific errors, and decision-curve net benefit, treating t = 0.10 as a reference anchor. We compared no recalibration with common and group-specific cross-fitted isotonic recalibration, evaluated a refit without the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), and performed a temporal-holdout analysis. Overall area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.876, with similar sex-marginal discrimination in women and men (0.878 vs 0.875). Calibration-in-the-large was -1.02 overall, -0.86 in frail, and -1.34 in prefrail patients; the 6-event nonfrail stratum was not estimable. At t = 0.10, net benefit was positive in frail and negative in prefrail patients in the source cohort, but negative prefrail utility did not persist in the ascertainable-period (2018-2022) and temporal analyses. Common recalibration moved overall calibration-in-the-large from -1.020 to -0.007. Removing SMOTE shifted overall calibration but did not reduce the reserve gradient. Temporal-holdout AUROC was 0.851 with persistent overprediction. Present-on-admission coding was effectively absent before 2018; prevalence-dependent results were therefore additionally reported for the ascertainable 2018-2022 period, and ascertainment differed by physiological reserve. Discrimination-only or sex-marginal evaluation would have missed deployment-relevant subgroup heterogeneity, while endpoint ascertainment affected prevalence-dependent interpretation. Joint subgroup evaluation can identify deployment-relevant limitations missed by aggregate metrics. Prospective validation with comparable outcome ascertainment remains necessary before clinical deployment.
items.zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA] 我们审计了一个手术结束时术后感染模型在临床相关亚组中的部署就绪度，并评估了对亚组校准不良的缓解情况。我们分析了10 719例手术（2014-2022年）的折外预测，其中包含504例入院时存在（present-on-admission，POA）编码的术后感染事件，并按记录的性别、年龄和一个临床生理储备替代指标进行分析。我们评估了区分度、校准、阈值特异性错误和决策曲线净获益，将 t = 0.10 作为参考锚点。我们将不重新校准与共同的和组特异性的交叉拟合等渗重校准进行比较，评估了不使用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）的重新拟合，并进行了时间留出分析。总体受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.876，女性和男性的性别边际区分度相似（0.878 vs 0.875）。整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）总体为 -1.02，衰弱患者为 -0.86，前衰弱患者为 -1.34；6个事件的非衰弱层不可估计。在 t = 0.10 时，源队列中衰弱患者的净获益为正，前衰弱患者为负，但前衰弱患者的负效用未在可确定期（2018-2022年）和时间分析中持续存在。共同重校准将总体整体校准从 -1.020 变为 -0.007。移除SMOTE改变了总体校准，但未降低储备梯度。时间留出 AUROC 为 0.851，并持续存在过度预测。入院时存在编码在2018年前实际上缺失；因此，还报告了可确定期2018-2022年的患病率依赖结果，且确定情况因生理储备而异。仅区分度或性别边际评估会漏掉与部署相关的亚组异质性，而终点确定影响患病率依赖的解释。联合亚组评估可以识别被总体指标漏掉的部署相关局限性。在临床部署前，仍需要具有可比结局确定的前瞻性验证。

items.abstract: Medical large language models achieving high benchmark accuracy exhibit unexplained variability in clinical tasks, producing errors that clinicians cannot safeguard against. We evaluated clinical reasoning stability in GPT-5, MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, and OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B using 3035 systematic perturbations from physician-validated oncology SOAP, brief vignette, and MIMIC cases. We trained sparse autoencoders on 1 billion tokens from 50,000 MIMIC-IV clinical notes to decompose their internal representation. We find models exhibit dramatic reasoning instability, shifting staging accuracy by over 50% based solely on prompt format, or generating definitive staging in clinically insufficient scenarios. Sparse autoencoder analysis revealed hierarchical encoding in MedGemma, where high-magnitude features encode lexical identity and low-magnitude features encode contextual meaning. OpenBioLLM distributes information uniformly. We demonstrate that these internal encoding structures differentially affect retrieval and reasoning interventions, suggesting interventions effective for one architecture may harm another. These results motivate architecture-specific safety validation as a component of pre-deployment evaluation for medical LLMs.
items.zh_abstract: 医学大语言模型虽在基准测试中达到高准确率，却在临床任务中表现出无法解释的变异性，产生临床医生无法防范的错误。我们使用来自经医生验证的肿瘤学SOAP、简要病例摘要和MIMIC病例的3035个系统性扰动，评估了GPT-5、MedGemma-27B-Text-IT和OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B的临床推理稳定性。我们在来自50,000份MIMIC-IV临床记录的10亿个token上训练稀疏自编码器，以分解其内部表征。我们发现模型表现出显著的推理不稳定性：仅因提示格式不同，分期准确率就会变化超过50%；或在临床信息不足的情况下生成确定性分期。稀疏自编码器分析揭示了MedGemma中的分层编码，其中高幅值特征编码词汇身份，低幅值特征编码上下文语义。OpenBioLLM则均匀分布信息。我们证明，这些内部编码结构对检索和推理干预产生不同影响，提示对一种架构有效的干预可能损害另一种架构。这些结果支持将针对特定架构的安全性验证作为医学大语言模型部署前评估的组成部分。

items.abstract: Generating clinical synthetic text represents an effective solution for common clinical NLP issues like sparsity and privacy. This paper aims to conduct a systematic review on generating synthetic medical free-text by formulating quantitative analysis to three research questions concerning (i) the purpose of generation, (ii) the techniques, and (iii) the evaluation methods. We searched PubMed, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, Scopus, IEEE, Google Scholar, and arXiv databases for publications associated with generating synthetic medical unstructured free-text. We have identified 94 relevant articles out of 1,398 collected ones. A great deal of attention has been given to the generation of synthetic medical text from 2018 onwards, where the main purpose of such a generation is towards text augmentation, assistive writing, corpus building, privacy-preserving, annotation, and usefulness. Transformer architectures were the main predominant technique used to generate the text, especially the GPTs. On the other hand, there were four main aspects of evaluation, including similarity, privacy, structure, and utility, where utility was the most frequent method used to assess the generated synthetic medical text. Although the generated synthetic medical text demonstrated a moderate possibility to act as real medical documents in different downstream NLP tasks, it has proven to be a great asset as augmented, complementary to the real documents, towards improving the accuracy and overcoming sparsity/undersampling issues. Yet, privacy is still a major issue behind generating synthetic medical text, where more human assessments are needed to check for the existence of any sensitive information. Despite that, advances in generating synthetic medical text will considerably accelerate the adoption of workflows and pipeline development, discarding the time-consuming legalities of data transfer.
items.zh_abstract: 生成临床合成文本是解决稀疏性和隐私等常见临床NLP问题的有效方案。本文旨在通过围绕三个研究问题开展定量分析，对合成医学自由文本的生成进行系统综述，这三个问题涉及（i）生成目的、（ii）技术和（iii）评估方法。我们检索了PubMed、ScienceDirect、Web of Science、Scopus、IEEE、Google Scholar和arXiv数据库中与生成合成医学非结构化自由文本相关的出版物。我们从1,398篇收集到的文章中识别出94篇相关文章。自2018年起，合成医学文本的生成受到大量关注，此类生成的主要目的包括文本增强、辅助写作、语料库构建、隐私保护、注释和实用性。Transformer架构是用于生成文本的主要主流技术，尤其是各类GPT。另一方面，评估主要有四个方面，包括相似性、隐私、结构和效用，其中效用是评估所生成合成医学文本最常用的方法。尽管所生成的合成医学文本在不同下游NLP任务中表现出作为真实医学文档的中等可能性，但已证明其作为真实文档的增强和补充具有重要价值，可提高准确性并克服稀疏性/欠采样问题。然而，隐私仍是生成合成医学文本背后的主要问题，需要更多人工作业评估以检查是否存在任何敏感信息。尽管如此，合成医学文本生成方面的进展将显著加速工作流程的采用和流水线开发，摆脱数据转移中耗时的法律合规问题。

items.abstract: Persistent fever after initiating intravenous antibiotics is common in hospitalized patients with cancer and often leads to additional imaging and antimicrobial escalation. Early identification of patients unlikely to remain febrile could provide additional information during clinical reassessment. We developed and externally validated machine learning models to predict persistent fever 48-72 h after antibiotic initiation using electronic health records from two academic hospitals. Adult cancer patients with fever within 24-48 h of treatment were included. Models incorporated demographics, comorbidities, laboratory results, vital signs, and temperature patterns. The best-performing model achieved an AUROC of 0.82 (95% CI 0.79-0.84) internally and 0.78 (95% CI 0.77-0.79) externally. Temperature-related variables were the dominant predictors. Decision curve analysis demonstrated positive net benefit across much of the evaluated threshold range. Retrospective assessment suggested that approximately one quarter of antibiotic escalations and chest CT scans occurred in patients correctly predicted not to remain febrile, highlighting the potential contextual value of fever predictions. These findings indicate that short-term fever persistence can be predicted with clinically meaningful accuracy using routine data. However, clinical use should be limited to an adjunctive role rather than standalone rule-out decision-making, and prospective studies are required to evaluate safety, clinician uptake, and real-world impact.
items.zh_abstract: 在开始静脉注射抗生素后持续发热在住院癌症患者中很常见，并且常导致额外影像学检查和抗菌治疗升级。早期识别不太可能持续发热的患者可在临床再评估期间提供额外信息。我们开发并外部验证了机器学习模型，利用两家学术医院的电子健康记录预测抗生素开始后48-72小时的持续发热。纳入在治疗24-48小时内发热的成年癌症患者。模型纳入人口学特征、合并症、实验室结果、生命体征和体温模式。表现最佳的模型在内部达到AUROC 0.82（95% CI 0.79-0.84），在外部达到0.78（95% CI 0.77-0.79）。体温相关变量是最主要的预测因素。决策曲线分析显示，在评估阈值范围的大部分区间内具有正向净获益。回顾性评估提示，大约四分之一的抗生素升级和胸部CT扫描发生在被正确预测为不会持续发热的患者中，突显了发热预测的潜在情境价值。这些发现表明，使用常规数据可以以具有临床意义的准确度预测短期发热持续。然而，临床使用应仅限于辅助作用，而非独立的排除决策，并且需要前瞻性研究评估安全性、临床医生接受度和真实世界影响。

items.abstract: The electronic health record (EHR) comprises structured and unstructured data, both of which are integral for comprehensively representing patient history. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has enabled the incorporation of unstructured data modalities into machine learning models that leverage EHR data. In this systematic review, we characterize studies that utilize LLM-enabled multimodal predictive modeling with EHR data. Following a screening of 641 studies, 57 met inclusion criteria. We identified three strategies for LLM-based multimodal integration: embedding, extraction, and text fusion. Delineated by the format of the unstructured data at the time of fusion, all strategies yielded performance gains (average 6.4% increase) over single modality models. LLMs facilitated modeling by generating note-embeddings for downstream prediction, extracting clinically informative variables, and summarizing long text documents prior to integration. Building on our review, we identified LLM-enhanced predictive modeling considerations that include sample size, interpretability, and computational costs. This study supports the potential value of LLMs for EHR-based predictive modeling and provides a framework for future multimodal modeling tools.

items.abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes may reduce documentation burden, but little is known about their adoption during enterprise-scale ambulatory rollout. We conducted a retrospective observational cohort study of 2901 ambulatory clinicians at an integrated academic health system using linked electronic health record and vendor usage data from December 2024 through May 2025. Clinician adoption was defined as any use during the study period, and monthly visit-level uptake as the proportion of eligible ambulatory visits in which the ambient AI scribe was used. Adoption and uptake varied substantially across practice settings, specialties, and clinician types. Clinician-level adoption was highest in community internal medicine (67%), community general pediatrics (69%), and academic neurology (53%), and lowest in academic general surgery (16%), obstetrics and gynecology (18%), and psychiatry (19%). Community attending physicians and advanced practice providers showed marked increases in median visit-level uptake, reaching approximately 80%-90% in some groups by May 2025. Distinct longitudinal patterns included slow and steady adoption, early use followed by discontinuation, transient use, and late adoption. These findings suggest that implementation support and evaluation strategies should be tailored to local practice context rather than applied uniformly across a health system.

items.abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The core objective of deformable image registration (DIR), estimating a displacement vector field that aligns two images, is fundamentally the same across imaging modalities and anatomical regions. Although this shared objective should imply the use of foundation models, most deep learning approaches for DIR operate within narrow domain-specific settings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) are the predominant choice for foundation models in many image processing tasks due to their excellent generalization capabilities and robustness to domain shifts. However, their use remains largely underexplored for DIR, which we attribute to a lack of suitable pre-training schemes. To address this need, we introduce MPM-Reg, a transferable, modality-agnostic training paradigm based on masked position modeling (MPM), enabling the use of fully transformer-based models as foundation models for image registration. Unlike conventional masked data modeling, which predicts the content of masked image patches, MPM masks the positional information and predicts the spatial relationship between image patches. Initially, we employ MPM on single images, which naturally aligns self-supervised pre-training of ViTs with the downstream registration task. Subsequently, we extend MPM to predict the positions of target patches within source images, re-formulating DIR through the lens of MPM. Experiments across eleven diverse datasets demonstrate MPM-Reg's competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, MPM-Reg benefits from heterogeneous multi-domain data, which degrades the performance of existing methods, paving the way for scalable foundation models for DIR.
items.zh_abstract: [IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging] 可变形图像配准（DIR）的核心目标是估计一个使两幅图像对齐的位移向量场，这一目标在成像模态和解剖区域之间从根本上相同。尽管这一共同目标应意味着使用基础模型，但大多数用于 DIR 的深度学习方法仍在狭窄的特定领域设置中运行。视觉 Transformer（ViT）因其出色的泛化能力以及对领域偏移的鲁棒性，在许多图像处理任务中是基础模型的主要选择。然而，它们在 DIR 中的使用仍很大程度上未被充分探索，我们将其归因于缺乏合适的预训练方案。为满足这一需求，我们提出 MPM-Reg，一种基于掩码位置建模（MPM）的可迁移、模态无关的训练范式，使完全基于 Transformer 的模型能够作为图像配准的基础模型。与预测掩码图像块内容的传统掩码数据建模不同，MPM 掩蔽位置信息并预测图像块之间的空间关系。首先，我们在单幅图像上使用 MPM，这自然地将 ViT 的自监督预训练与下游配准任务对齐。随后，我们将 MPM 扩展为预测源图像中目标图像块的位置，通过 MPM 的视角重新表述 DIR。在十一个多样化数据集上的实验表明，MPM-Reg 与最先进基线相比具有有竞争力的性能。关键是，MPM-Reg 受益于异构多领域数据，而这些数据会降低现有方法的性能，从而为可扩展的 DIR 基础模型铺平道路。

items.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into clinical medical imaging has advanced diagnostics but also poses challenges in maintaining long-term reliability as input data change. To address this, we present MMC+, a modular framework for scalable drift monitoring that builds on our CheXstray framework for real-time drift detection using multi-modal data concordance (MMC). MMC+ provides a flexible architecture that enables cost-effective continuous performance monitoring in real-world healthcare settings. The framework’s capabilities include aggregating information from multiple data streams using statistical tests or distance metrics, leveraging foundation model embeddings to remove the need for site-specific encoder training, and quantifying uncertainty to better communicate drift significance. Validated with data from Massachusetts General Hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic, MMC+ effectively detects significant data shifts that correlate with performance changes and indicates when AI systems may deviate from acceptable performance bounds. The code for MMC+ is publicly available (Link: https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus ), promoting broader adoption of AI solutions in clinical settings. Our framework significantly advances drift detection while promoting transparency and collaboration in clinical AI research.
items.zh_abstract: 将人工智能（AI）整合到临床医学影像中促进了诊断，但也带来了在输入数据变化时保持长期可靠性的挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出MMC+，这是一个可扩展漂移监测的模块化框架，建立在我们CheXstray框架之上，该框架利用多模态数据一致性（multi-modal data concordance，MMC）进行实时漂移检测。MMC+提供了一种灵活的架构，可在真实世界医疗环境中实现具有成本效益的持续性能监测。该框架的能力包括：使用统计检验或距离度量聚合来自多个数据流的信息，利用基础模型嵌入以消除对站点特定编码器训练的需求，以及量化不确定性以更好地传达漂移显著性。MMC+在COVID-19大流行期间使用马萨诸塞州总医院（Massachusetts General Hospital）的数据进行了验证，能够有效检测与性能变化相关的显著数据偏移，并指示AI系统何时可能偏离可接受的性能界限。MMC+的代码已公开（链接：https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus ），促进AI解决方案在临床环境中的更广泛采用。我们的框架显著推进了漂移检测，同时促进了临床AI研究的透明性和合作。

items.abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Radiology is adopting artificial intelligence (AI) faster than it is studying what AI does to radiologists' perceptual expertise and interpretive skill. The question has partly shifted from whether these tools perform well on benchmark tasks to what happens to clinical judgment when use of these tools becomes routine. Two risks accompany this transition: automation bias, the tendency to follow AI suggestions without adequate scrutiny, and deskilling, the erosion of perceptual and interpretive ability through disuse, typically revealed when AI support is withdrawn. Incorrect AI output degrades accuracy regardless of experience, the benefit of assistance varies unpredictably across readers and tasks, and performance falls after AI withdrawal; neither risk has been studied longitudinally in radiology. A confidence-stratified triage model is proposed in which calibrated AI confidence, not findings alone, routes cases to low-, intermediate-, or high-confidence streams: output withheld until independent reading, shown with uncertainty signals and a checklist, or shown with random blinded audit. Demonstrated local confidence calibration is a precondition for deployment, and stream thresholds and audit rates should be weighted by task and potential clinical harm, not error probability alone. Rather than applying one workflow to every case, the model redistributes radiologist attention to where AI error is most likely and most consequential, operationalizing four principles: keeping the radiologist in the decision loop, making AI uncertainty visible, inserting targeted cognitive friction, and governing the human-AI interaction as a system. A research agenda to determine whether these countermeasures reduce automation bias and skill erosion in practice is also proposed.

Artificial intelligence] 放射学采用人工智能（AI）的速度，快于研究AI对放射科医师感知专长和判读技能所产生影响的速度。问题已部分从这些工具是否在基准任务上表现良好，转向当这些工具的使用成为常规时临床判断会发生什么。这一转变伴随两种风险：自动化偏差（automation bias），即在没有充分审查的情况下遵循AI建议的倾向；以及去技能化（deskilling），即因不使用而导致感知和判读能力侵蚀，通常在AI支持被撤除时显现。错误的AI输出会降低准确性，无论经验如何；辅助的获益在不同阅片者和任务之间不可预测地变化；并且在AI撤除后表现下降；这两种风险均未在放射学中进行纵向研究。提出一种置信度分层分诊模型，其中经过校准的AI置信度而非仅依据发现，将病例分流至低、中、高置信度流程：输出暂不提供直至完成独立判读；在显示不确定性信号和清单的情况下显示输出；或在随机盲法审核下显示输出。已证明的本地置信度校准是部署的前提，流程阈值和审核率应根据任务和潜在临床危害加权，而非仅依据错误概率。该模型不是对每个病例应用一种工作流程，而是将放射科医师的注意力重新分配到AI错误最可能且最具后果的地方，并将四项原则操作化：让放射科医师保持在决策环路中、使AI不确定性可见、插入有针对性的认知摩擦，以及将人-AI交互作为一个系统进行治理。还提出了一个研究议程，以确定这些对策在实践中是否减少自动化偏差和技能侵蚀。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To compare patient trust in educational health contentand the physician providing it, when authorship is attributed to a physician or generative artificial intelligence (AI). In a preregistered randomized, parallel survey study, participants read a health education article. Individuals were randomized to 1 of 4 conditions, attributing authorship of an identical article to (1) a physician author, (2) generative AI, (3) a physician assisted by AI (hybrid authorship), or (4) no author. Pregnant or postpartum English-speaking US adults (n = 400) were recruited in August-October 2025 via an online survey panel. Eighty percent passed timing and attention checks. Participants rated article engagement, content trust, and trust in the (hypothetical) recommending physician with Likert-scales. Bonferroni corrections were applied to post hoc pairwise comparisons (α = 0.05). Among participants who correctly recalled authorship (n = 195), AI-only authorship was associated with lower trust in content (mean, 9.43 vs 11.11; P = .001) and the recommending physician (mean, 8.93 vs 10.84; P = .03) compared with physician-only authorship, while hybrid authorship did not differ significantly from physician-only authorship for either outcome (content: P = .08; physician: P > .99). Sensitivity analyses including all participants (n = 321) were generally consistent with the primary findings. Engagement did not differ significantly across conditions in the primary analytic sample. As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical care, how AI involvement and physician oversight are communicated to patients could have important implications for patient trust. AI authorship was associated with reduced trust in patient-facing education despite identical, clinician-written content.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 在作者署名归属于医生或生成式人工智能（AI）时，比较患者对教育性健康内容及提供该内容的医生的信任。在一项预注册的随机、平行调查研究中，参与者阅读一篇健康教育文章。个体被随机分配到4种条件之一，将同一篇文章的作者署名归于（1）医生作者、（2）生成式AI、（3）由AI协助的医生（混合署名）或（4）无作者。妊娠期或产后英语美国成年人（n = 400）于2025年8月至10月通过在线调查面板招募。80%通过了时间与注意力检查。参与者使用Likert量表对文章参与度、内容信任以及对（假设的）推荐医生的信任进行评分。事后两两比较采用Bonferroni校正（α = 0.05）。在正确回忆作者身份的参与者（n = 195）中，与仅医生署名相比，仅AI署名与对内容的信任较低相关（均值，9.43 vs 11.11；P = .001）以及对推荐医生的信任较低相关（均值，8.93 vs 10.84；P = .03），而混合署名在两项结局上均与仅医生署名无显著差异（内容：P = .08；医生：P > .99）。纳入所有参与者（n = 321）的敏感性分析总体上与主要发现一致。在主要分析样本中，参与度在各条件间无显著差异。随着生成式AI日益融入临床护理，如何向患者传达AI参与和医生监督可能对患者信任产生重要影响。尽管内容相同且由临床医生撰写，AI署名与对面向患者教育的信任降低相关。

items.zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 放射学报告是影像诊断的最终临床记录，其准确性直接对患者安全至关重要。然而，在工作量不断升级的情况下，人工审核仍不足以大规模捕捉报告中的细微错误。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在医学文本处理中已展现出相当大的前景，但既往研究主要局限于单一成像模态的放射学报告文本或包含合成错误的数据集。本研究旨在评估通用LLMs对来自多种成像模态（X射线、计算机断层扫描[CT]和磁共振成像[MRI]）、多解剖区域和多中心临床环境的放射学报告文本进行质量保证的可行性、准确性和泛化性，并与不同资历的放射科医师进行头对头比较。从中心1（2025年3月至2025年5月）回顾性收集来自上述3种成像模态和5个解剖区域（头部、胸部、腹部、脊柱和膝部）的放射学报告文本，并使用由临床医生标注的5类错误分类法（类型1：解释性；类型2：事实性）进行审核。五种LLMs（Qwen3、GPT-5.4 Pro、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Llama 4和DeepSeek-V3.1）在10,000份随机抽取的报告上进行基准测试，表现最佳的模型在完整队列上接受评估。使用按成像模态分层、错误富集的挑战集，与3名放射科医师（3-10年经验）进行盲法头对头比较。放射科医师随后使用5点Likert量表对模型生成的解释进行评分。在独立外部队列中评估跨中心性能。同两名资深放射科医师使用相同方案对来自两个中心的报告进行标注，并通过共识解决分歧。中心1共有4.6%（4431/95,582）的报告包含至少一个经确认的文本内部错误。所选模型Qwen3达到报告级灵敏度、特异度、阳性预测值和F1分数分别为0.99、0.99、0.90和0.94，在来自3种成像模态和多个解剖区域的报告中均表现良好，并且对事实性错误的检测优于解释性错误。在错误富集的挑战集中，其错误实例精确类别召回率超过放射科医师（0.96 vs 0.45-0.67；P<.001），且平均任务完成时间更短（每份报告5.80 vs 55.80-67.80秒）。

items.abstract: Foundation models trained on longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can predict clinical diagnoses years in the future, making them a potential tool for disease screening. We developed TRACER (Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations), a decoder-based foundation model pretrained on data from over 4.5 million patients from four health systems, and evaluated it on 16 incident diseases at 1-, 2-, and 5-year horizons in more than 2 million patients from two health systems excluded from model development. In contrast to typical evaluations that focus on global metrics (e.g., AUROC), we measured performance at the low false-positive rates that are realistic for screening. We found that TRACER retained its discrimination in external health systems, and at 95% specificity, the patients it flagged were up to eight times more likely to be diagnosed within a year than unselected patients. Evaluating at this operating point also revealed what global metrics alone did not: detection and false-alert burden varied across diseases and health systems, even when discrimination appeared stable. Our results illustrate the potential of foundation models for screening and underscore the need for evaluation in health systems excluded from development to assess disease detection and false-alert burden at levels appropriate for intended clinical use.}

items.abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.
items.zh_abstract: 在精神科实践中，临床接诊访谈仍是主要的诊断工具，要求临床医生在建立融洽关系的同时，理清复杂且相互重叠的表现。在此，我们展示，模拟环境中的多轮强化学习（reinforcement learning, RL）可提高语言模型在结构化文本精神科接诊中的表现，涵盖病史采集、鉴别诊断和初始管理计划。在一项随机、双盲交叉研究中（$N = 60$ 对匹配场景，120次接诊），将经RL训练的智能体与接受相同提示的基础模型进行比较，32名委员会认证的精神科医生角色扮演标准化患者，而由另一个由15名独立、委员会认证的精神科医生组成的小组对去标识化转录文本进行评分。训练后智能体在76.7%的匹配场景对中优于基础模型（$p < 0.0001$），并在改编的临床检查评分量表（$d_z = 0.77$，$p < 0.0001$）、以患者为中心的沟通（82.0% 对 65.2%，$p < 0.001$）和鉴别诊断适当性（68.3% 对 33.3%，$p < 0.001$）方面均有改善。在127个经精神科医生验证的模拟接诊场景中，训练后智能体的临床评分量表得分几乎为基础模型的两倍（0.706 对 0.379；复合奖励 0.564 对 0.294，$p < 0.0001$）。为系统探究对话安全性，我们建立了两个德尔菲共识分类体系，分别关于临床安全风险和关系能力，并从中衍生出256个具有挑战性的对抗性表现；我们发现，在模拟环境中进行训练使急性安全风险的分诊不足减少了一半以上（12.9% 对 30.5%，$p < 0.0001$）。因此，模拟环境为训练和压力测试精神科对话智能体提供了受控测试平台，其收益可迁移至由精神科医生实施的接诊中，但残余差距仍需要保障措施和临床医生监督。

items.abstract: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters. Current artificial intelligence (AI) solutions remain limited, typically operating as opaque "black boxes" or focusing on narrow tasks that fail to capture the holistic, guideline-driven reasoning of a clinician. Here we introduce EchoChat, a generative multimodal vision-language model that performs comprehensive echocardiographic analysis to support clinician interpretation. By emulating the cognitive workflow of a cardiologist, EchoChat integrates vast medical knowledge with a chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to explicitly ground its conclusions in visual evidence. Trained on echocardiography-instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations, our model establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse cohorts from six international medical centers. It supports the broadest diagnostic scope of 33 cardiac conditions and findings, including 15 newly added conditions for which it achieves an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations. It surpasses existing best-performing foundation models in cardiac condition recognition (improving average recall by 13.54% on shared tasks) and quantification (average R2 score increase of 0.275 on shared tasks). Furthermore, in a source-blinded echocardiographer reader study, echocardiography reports co-generated with EchoChat were rated higher in diagnostic accuracy and completeness by two senior echocardiographers, and improved diagnostic performance from 72.78% to 82.75% in terms of F1 score over routine-reader only reports. These results demonstrate that integrating clinical reasoning into multimodal AI can democratize specialist expertise and transform the standard of cardiovascular care.
items.zh_abstract: 超声心动图是心血管诊断的基石，但其全球应用受到经验丰富解读人员严重短缺的制约。当前的人工智能（AI）解决方案仍然有限，通常作为不透明的“黑箱”运行，或聚焦于狭窄任务，无法捕捉临床医生整体性、指南驱动的推理。在此我们介绍EchoChat，一种生成式多模态视觉-语言模型，可执行全面的超声心动图分析以支持临床医生解读。通过模拟心脏病学家的认知工作流程，EchoChat将大量医学知识与思维链推理机制相结合，将其结论明确建立在视觉证据之上。基于来自46,358次检查的超声心动图-指令对进行训练，我们的模型在来自六家国际医学中心的不同队列中确立了新的最先进水平。它支持最广泛的诊断范围，涵盖33种心脏疾病和发现，包括15种新增疾病/状况，在可用的外部评估中其平均F1为73.7%。它在心脏疾病识别（在共同任务上平均召回率提高13.54%）和定量分析（在共同任务上平均R2分数提高0.275）方面超越现有表现最佳的基础模型。此外，在一项对来源设盲的超声心动图医师阅片研究中，与EchoChat共同生成的超声心动图报告被两名资深超声心动图医师评为诊断准确性和完整性更高，并且相较于仅由常规阅片者出具的报告，F1分数从72.78%提高到82.75%，改善了诊断性能。这些结果表明，将临床推理整合到多模态AI中可以使专科专长普及化，并改变心血管诊疗标准。

items.abstract: Of all melanoma patients who develop distant metastasis over time, 41% were initially diagnosed with stage I/II. More accurate prognostic models are needed to select patients for potential (neo)adjuvant therapy. We hypothesise that histopathological features in whole slide images (WSIs) from primary early-stage melanomas provide additional information beyond American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) stage. We utilised data from the population-based Dutch Early-Stage Melanoma (D-ESMEL) study. This included a discovery set (n=328) of case-control sets matched on follow-up time and known prognostic features (i.e. Breslow thickness, ulceration, age, and sex) and a validation cohort based on >5,500 patients following a nested case-control (NCC) design with stage-matched controls (n=266). We developed an end-to-end deep learning workflow to automatically extract relevant patches from WSIs and predict patient-level metastatic risk based on histopathological features independent of AJCC stage. The discovery set served as a training set for the workflow using 10-fold cross-validation. The prognostic performance of this model and its independence from clinical risk factors was evaluated in the validation cohort using odds ratios (OR) and the weighted C-index. We achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.88 (mean: 0.81; 95% CI: 0.77-0.85) in the best validation fold of the discovery set. In the validation cohort, metastatic risk predictions from the deep learning model were an independent prognostic factor (adjusted OR: 1.97; p<0.01). Combining the deep learning predictions (C-index: 0.86) with AJCC stage (C-index: 0.80) yielded the highest C-index of 0.87, significantly improving the C-index compared to AJCC stage alone (p<0.001). Our histopathology-based deep learning model was rigorously evaluated in a population-based cohort and demonstrated added prognostic value beyond AJCC stage. Further investigations of the underlying biological features could improve clinical decision making and patient outcomes.
items.zh_abstract: 在所有随时间发生远处转移的黑色素瘤患者中，41% 初诊时为 I/II 期。需要更准确的预后模型来选择可能接受（新）辅助治疗的患者。我们假设，原发性早期黑色素瘤全切片图像（WSIs）中的组织病理学特征可提供超出美国癌症联合委员会（AJCC）分期的额外信息。我们使用了基于人群的荷兰早期黑色素瘤（D-ESMEL）研究的数据。该研究包括一个发现集（n=328），由按随访时间和已知预后特征（即 Breslow 厚度、溃疡、年龄和性别）匹配的病例-对照集组成；以及一个基于 >5,500 例患者的验证队列，采用巢式病例对照（NCC）设计并设置分期匹配的对照（n=266）。我们开发了一个端到端深度学习工作流程，从 WSIs 中自动提取相关图像块，并基于独立于 AJCC 分期的组织病理学特征预测患者水平的转移风险。发现集作为该工作流程的训练集，采用 10 折交叉验证。在验证队列中，使用比值比（OR）和加权 C 指数评估该模型的预后性能及其独立于临床风险因素的程度。在发现集的最佳验证折中，我们达到了 0.88 的平衡准确率（均值：0.81；95% CI：0.77-0.85）。在验证队列中，深度学习模型的转移风险预测是一个独立预后因素（校正 OR：1.97；p<0.01）。将深度学习预测（C 指数：0.86）与 AJCC 分期（C 指数：0.80）结合，得到最高的 C 指数 0.87，与单独 AJCC 分期相比显著提高了 C 指数（p<0.001）。我们基于组织病理学的深度学习模型在基于人群的队列中经过严格评估，并显示出超出 AJCC 分期的附加预后价值。对潜在生物学特征的进一步研究可改善临床决策和患者结局。

items.abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundNeurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's pose significant diagnostic challenges because they are incurable. Their symptoms often overlap with those of normal ageing and involve progressive neuronal loss. This makes early prediction, proper diagnosis, and ongoing monitoring crucial at every stage of the disease. Deep learning has become a useful tool for handling different types of data. However, the performance of these models relies heavily on the availability and variety of data, making it important to characterize datasets.ObjectiveThis PRISMA-based systematic review looks at 111 studies from 2019 to April 2026, organized into three clinical stages of neurodegenerative diseases: early prediction, diagnosis, and progression.MethodsEach study is assessed across four dimensions: data type (neuroimaging or non-neuroimaging), datasets (open-access, self-created, or hybrid), deep learning model architecture, and the use of explainable AI.ResultsMRI is the only imaging modality that spans all three stages. Speech is the most common non-neuroimaging method for diagnosis, while gait is used only for diagnosis and progression. The ADNI and PPMI datasets are the most commonly used. Self-created datasets introduce new modalities such as ECG and iPSCs, which are not found in open-access datasets. CNNs are the leading models for neuroimaging tasks, while LSTMs and RNNs capture temporal patterns in longitudinal datasets. Survival models are exclusively used for ALS and LATE. Fewer than 6% of the studies used confirmed XAI. Only 2 of the 111 studies validated their results on an independent external cohort.ConclusionThis review is the only one that covers all three disease stages across multiple neurodegenerative diseases.
items.zh_abstract: [Technology and Health Care（欧洲工程与医学学会官方期刊）]【背景】阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病因无法治愈而带来重大诊断挑战。其症状常与正常衰老的症状重叠，并涉及进行性神经元丢失。这使得在疾病的每个阶段进行早期预测、正确诊断和持续监测至关重要。深度学习已成为处理不同类型数据的有用工具。然而，这些模型的性能在很大程度上依赖于数据的可获得性和多样性，因此对数据集进行表征很重要。【目的】本项基于PRISMA的系统综述考察了2019年至2026年4月的111项研究，并按神经退行性疾病的三个临床阶段进行组织：早期预测、诊断和进展。【方法】每项研究均从四个维度进行评估：数据类型（神经影像或非神经影像）、数据集（开放获取、自建或混合）、深度学习模型架构，以及可解释人工智能（XAI）的使用情况。【结果】MRI是唯一涵盖全部三个阶段的影像模态。语音是诊断中最常用的非神经影像方法，而步态仅用于诊断和进展。ADNI和PPMI数据集是最常用的数据集。自建数据集引入了开放获取数据集中没有的新模态，如ECG和iPSCs。CNN是神经影像任务的主要模型，而LSTM和RNN用于捕捉纵向数据集中的时间模式。生存模型仅用于ALS和LATE。少于6%的研究使用了经确认的XAI。111项研究中仅有2项在独立外部队列上验证了其结果。【结论】本综述是唯一一项涵盖多种神经退行性疾病全部三个疾病阶段的综述。

items.abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] State space model (SSM) is a powerful tool in neuroscience field to characterize the dynamic nature of brain functions by elucidating the mechanism of how brain system transits between brain states and how underlying states give rise to the observed neural activities. Although tremendous efforts have been made to lend the power of deep learning and mathematical insight of SSM in various functional neuroimaging studies, current state-of-the-art methods lack a holistic view of brain state evolution as a self-organized dynamical system where each part of the brain is functionally inter-connected. Since the topological co-activation of functional fluctuations exhibits an intrinsic geometric pattern (symmetric and positive definite, SPD) on the Riemannian manifold, the call for understanding how a selective set of functional connectivities in the brain supports diverse behavior and cognition emerge a new machine learning scenario of manifold-based SSM for largescale functional neuroimages. To that end, we propose a geometric neural network of SSM, coined GeoMind, designed to uncover evolving brain states by tracking the trajectory of functional dynamics on a high-dimensional Riemannian manifold of SPD matrices. GeoMind demonstrates promising results in identifying specific brain states on task-based functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) data, as well as in diseases early diagnosis for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and Autism, by using resting-state fMRI. These results highlight the applicability of GeoMind in neuroscience research. To further evaluate generalizability of GeoMind, we applied GeoMind to electroencephalography (EEG) emotion datasets, outperforming competing methods and demonstrating scalability across neuroimaging modalities.
items.zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 状态空间模型（SSM）是神经科学领域中的一个强大工具，可通过阐明大脑系统如何在不同脑状态之间转换以及潜在状态如何产生观察到的神经活动的机制，来刻画脑功能的动态特性。尽管已在各种功能神经影像研究中投入大量努力，以借助深度学习的威力与SSM的数学洞见，当前最先进的方法仍缺乏一种整体视角，即把脑状态演化视为一个自组织的动力系统，其中大脑各部分在功能上相互连接。由于功能波动的拓扑共激活在黎曼流形上表现出一种内在几何模式（对称正定，SPD），理解大脑中一组选择性功能连接如何支持多样行为与认知的需求，催生了一个新的机器学习场景：面向大规模功能神经影像的基于流形的SSM。为此，我们提出一种SSM的几何神经网络，命名为GeoMind，旨在通过追踪SPD矩阵高维黎曼流形上功能动力学的轨迹来揭示演化中的脑状态。GeoMind在任务态功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据中识别特定脑状态，以及利用静息态fMRI对阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和自闭症进行疾病早期诊断方面，均展现出有前景的结果。这些结果凸显了GeoMind在神经科学研究中的适用性。为进一步评估GeoMind的泛化性，我们将GeoMind应用于脑电图（EEG）情绪数据集，其表现优于竞争方法，并展示了跨神经影像模态的可扩展性。
